Err.ChoicesNegative: The number of choices can't be negative.
Err.GroupNameRequired: Give the group a name (for example "Size" or "Fillings").
Err.GroupNameTaken: There is already a group called "{0}".
Err.GroupNeedsOption: Add at least one option to the group.
Err.GroupNotFound: That group was deleted at another till. Refresh and try again.
Err.GroupTwice: A group is ticked twice for this item.
Err.MinAboveMax: "At least" can't be more than "at most".
Err.MinAboveOptions: "At least" can't be more than the {0} options in the group.
Err.OptionNotOffered: That option isn't offered with "{0}" any more. Add the item again.
Err.StockNotTracked: "{0}" isn't counted in stock (it is made to order). Tick "Count in stock" in the item first.
Menu.CodeHint: Type the code at the till to add the item quickly. Left empty, the next free number is used.
Menu.InStockTip: Changed on the Inventory page (received, counted, written off).
Menu.NoGroupsYet: No modifier groups yet. Make them on the Modifiers page (Size, Fillings, Extras...).
Menu.OnTheMenu: On the menu (untick to take it off for good)
Menu.OptionsHint: Tick the questions the till asks when this item is ordered, in this order.
Menu.SoldOutNow: Sold out for now (the till refuses it until it's back)
Menu.ToggleSoldOutTip: Marks the selected item sold out, or back on sale
Menu.TrackStockHint: For packaged goods (cans, bottles, snacks). Items made to order are not counted.
Modifiers.DeleteUsedConfirm: Delete the group "{0}"? {1} items ask it; they will stop asking. Past sales keep their options.
Modifiers.HowManyHint: At least 1 makes the group required (a size). At most 1 means one answer only.
Modifiers.Intro: The questions the till asks when an item is ordered: size, fillings, milk, "no onions"... A group can be used by many items; choose which in each item's editor.
Modifiers.LoadFailed: The modifier groups couldn't be loaded.
Reports.About.Options: How many items were sold with each option, and what the options added to their price.
